adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-reviewed the paper-local XML, PDF text, figure captions, supplementary inventory, and linked DBAASP rows. The prior open ticket is resolved by source-supported Table 4 activity/toxicity rows and source-verified DBAASP RW16 cytotoxicity reconciliation; remaining cautions are explicit and nonblocking.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The paper studies membrane effects of basic/cell-penetrating/amphipathic peptides and includes CHO/MDCK toxicity/permeability, but it does not report microbial MIC/MBC rows.
Local supplementary assets resolve to publisher HTML/article pages and XML-listed MOV video captions; no structured supplemental activity/toxicity tables were present locally.
The toroidal/curvature mechanism is an author model supported by assays and figures; final wording preserves it as a model rather than direct molecular pore visualization.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The linked DBAASP assay and experiment rows for RW16 CHO cytotoxicity are source verified against Table 1 RW16 identity/modification and Table 4 RW16 CHO lethality at 10 uM; the literature row matches article metadata.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 4 contains parser-missed activity/toxicity values. Worker-2 captured all six-peptide values for calcein release, MDCK cell permeabilization, and CHO cell lethality with table locators and explicit no-unit rationale for binary endpoints.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism conclusions are bounded to directly reported membrane morphology, LUV leakage, MDCK permeability, and the author's model; no unsupported antimicrobial MIC or exact pore-size claim is added.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original blocking ticket is closed because source review replaced scaffold outputs, no blocking/major issue remains, and all remaining cautions are nonblocking.
